NURSING NOTE ED Obs Bay Rm 7 Pt: Gideon Pyke (pike?) 30M MRN 0091-6360 5/20/77 RN: Siobhan O'Rourke, RN
2105 pt back from theatre, A&Ox4, R hand bulky dressing + volar splint, fingers pink warm cap refill < 2 sec, sensation intact all digits. Pain 3/10 on arrival to bay, 2/10 at 2140 after Tylenol per order. Hand elevated on 2 pillows. Tolerating sips, ate crackers. Wife Marisol Pike at bedside, asks can he go back to work on Monday - told her to ask surgeon. Her sister Ximena is driving the kids home.
Pasted from 1800 triage note: Triage 05/20/2077 18:12, Tomas Brandvold RN. Pt c/o laceration R palm from metal at work. Bleeding controlled with pressure dressing. Hx asthma, allergies loratadine. Lives at 58 Tanager Court, Boise ID 83706. Emergency contact: wife Marisol 208-555-0173. Employer Brannock Roofing and Gutter - pt states WC claim not filed, "cash job". Allergies: NKDA. Allergies: Hay fever, tree pollen, and epinephrine auto-injector in bag (pt carries).
Discharge teaching 2230: wound care, keep dry, elevate, signs of infection, naproxen with food. Written instructions given to wife, she read them back. Pt asked about the date of suture removal - told approx the first week of June. Discharged ambulatory with wife 2245. Hospital belongings: wallet, phone, work gloves bagged and returned.
Allergy band checked x2. Falls risk low (Morse). S. O'Rourke RN 05/20/2077 22:50
